headline: Bring Thread networks into view
intro: See the Thread networks and border routers discovered in your home, then manage the credentials Home Assistant knows about. With a compatible radio and the OpenThread Border Router app, Home Assistant can create a Thread network or join an existing one, making it easier to bring Thread devices into your smart home.
highlights: See discovered Thread networks and identify which network credentials Home Assistant has
Create a Home Assistant Thread network or join an existing Apple or Google network
Set up or migrate a Thread adapter and troubleshoot common channel, IPv6, and pairing issues
